text:
zoe: quick postmortem follow-up from the two canary flaps this week. want a minimal, tracked remediation plan that covers owners, timelines, and recurring-pattern mitigation.

mira: +1. can you list concrete owners and short deadlines so we don't lose momentum? also include the exact telemetry signals that should auto-rollback.

sam: proposed signals in plain language: (A) error-rate jump >=4pp sustained for 4m, (B) p95 latency +200ms for 3m, (C) schema failure rate >0.2% in smoke test. auto-rollback if any true. cap initial blast radius to 0.5% and global canary cap 3%.

ben: additive: require at least one golden-prompt regression or malformed-response spike to page a human. otherwise let auto-rollback handle it. also add explicit "no model swap" lock during rollout window.

zoe: creating INF-8002 tracking card and will attach a table of action items. draft timeline: smoke tests + PRs by Tue EOD, infra review Wed AM, gated rollout Thu.

mira: i'll own dashboards/runbook. i'll add exact query defs and slack/pager mappings (pager for sev2+, slack for sev3). will also write an on-call snippet with steps to verify before unpausing.

sam: i'll implement rollback rule wiring + smoke harness. PR by Tue. harness will run schema checks, golden prompts, and a small synthetic traffic pattern. if smoke fails, it reports to INF-8002 and triggers rollback.

ben: i'll do the rollout-config + infra changes (feature-flag gating + no-swap enforcement). will add a small circuit-breaker so canary failures don't cascade. ETA Wed.

zoe: config prototype (will be committed):
```
rollout_policy: "minimal-guardrails"
initial_batch: 0.5%
progression: [2%, 8%]
max_canary: 3%
rollback_triggers:
  - id: "error_spike"
    metric: "error_rate"
    delta: 0.04
    window: "4m"
  - id: "latency_jump"
    metric: "p95_latency"
    delta_ms: 200
    window: "3m"
  - id: "schema_fail"
    metric: "schema_error_rate"
    threshold: 0.002
    window: "1m"
auto_rollback: true
pre_rollout_checks: [tokenizer_compat, no_model_swap, model-diff]
smoke_tests: run_after_each_batch
```

mira: important: record recurring incident categories in INF-8002. from the last 5 incidents we see three themes: tokenizer mismatch, unexpected model binary swap, and rollout with under-specified smoke tests. we'll add a pattern table and suggested mitigations.

sam: i'll add the smoke harness to CI so tests run automatically and results post back to the card. failing runs will block progression in the feature-flag controller.

ops-bot: INF-8002 created by @zoe; milestone: rollout-hardening-Q3.

ben: created calendar "Rollout Remediation Check" weekly until close; added owners as assignees on INF-8002.

zoe: owners summary (in-channel): sam -> rollback rules + smoke CI; ben -> rollout controller + infra + no-swap lock; mira -> dashboards + runbook + paging; zoe -> tracking card + PM follow-up. deadlines: PRs Tue EOD, infra review Wed, staged rollout Thu.

mira: i'll add a short guide for on-call: how to interpret each rollback trigger, how to safely override (requires 2 approvers), and steps to collect minimal evidence for post-action analysis.

sam: will tag PRs with INF-8002 and add automated test artifacts (logs + failing example prompts) to the ticket for faster triage.

ben: also adding a small post-rollout audit task: sample 1k responses from each batch and run automated QA scripts to detect silent regressions. failure rate >0.5% triggers immediate rollback.

zoe: adding a retrospective cadence: monthly "Canary Pattern Review" to revisit thresholds and adjust guardrails based on data. we'll log changes in INF-8002 and keep defaults conservative until we have 3 clean successful rollouts.

mira: sounds good. once PRs reference INF-8002 and the runbook is in place we'll reevaluate the initial batch size. for now keep it strict. :thumbsup:
